pages.title: Compendium Account
pages.text: Wild Glutinous Rice is an ordinary grain that grows naturally in fertile, moisture-rich environments. Though it lacks the concentrated essence of rare spiritual herbs, it remains a useful natural resource for mortals and low-level cultivators alike.

pages.title: Compendium Account
pages.text: Even those who seek immortality must remember that every cultivation journey begins in the mortal world.

pages.title: Where to Find
pages.text: Rivers, swamps, forests, flower forests, dark forests, jungles, sparse jungles, and bamboo jungles.
